bias.zh: 偏空 · 重回 5 日均线上方，测试 $397–399

read.en: Applied Materials rose 2.2% on Oct 27 to $395.93, trading between $385.31 and $398.95. It is above the falling 5-day ($389.1) and below the falling 10-day ($404.9), 30-day ($461.6) and 100-day ($511.4) and the rising 200-day ($442.9). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 13 and below zero, histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 8 ($427.55), and RSI is 34.
read.zh: 应用材料 10月27日上涨 2.2%，收于 $395.93，盘中区间 $385.31–398.95。股价位于下行的 5 日均线（$389.1）上方，低于下行的 10 日（$404.9）、30 日（$461.6）和 100 日均线（$511.4）以及上行的 200 日均线（$442.9）。MACD 自 10月13日起位于信号线及零轴下方，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 10月8日起看空（$427.55），RSI 为 34。

read.en: The close cleared $389–393 (5-day, Oct 26 high), now support; the $399 high stalled at the May 19 and Oct 20 lows. Resistance is $397.4–399, then $404.9–407.3 (10-day, Oct 16 low) and $414 (Oct 21 high). Support is $389–393, then $377–380 (April lows, Oct 26 low) and $372.8 (Oct 23 low). A close above $399 would target $405–414; below $389, $378–380.
